svg.title: Hackathons: winner, Eightfold.ai Internal T2 Hackathon, May 2026; participant, Smart India Hackathon 2024
svg.text: Built Skill-Pilot, a career counselling portal for school students. It uses
the Gemini API to choose each next question from what the student has told it
so far, evaluates their answers, and suggests career paths with a roadmap, in
